cmd:
set -e
cd /opt/trading-bot
cp wallbot.py wallbot.py.bak_pre_floor
systemctl stop wallbot
cp wallbot_new.py wallbot.py
sed -i 's#ob_wall3.db#ob_wall4.db#' study2.py study3.py study4.py
chown tbot:tbot wallbot.py study2.py study3.py study4.py
systemctl start wallbot
sleep 110
systemctl is-active wallbot
journalctl -u wallbot --since "-2min" --no-pager | grep -v "Started\|Stopped\|Consumed\|Stopping" | tail -5
ls -la ob_wall3.db ob_wall4.db | awk '{print $5, $9}'
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/api | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(len(d['syms']), 'пар;', [(x['name'][:-4], x['state']) for x in d['syms']][:12])"
for s in AVAXUSDT SUIUSDT; do curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:8091/book?sym=$s" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print(d['sym'], 'порог', round(d['floor'] or 0), 'стенка', d['wall'] and round(d['wall']['usdt']), 'скопление', d.get('clus') and round(d['clus']['usdt']))"; done
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('/opt/trading-bot/ob_wall4.db')
print('таблицы:', [r[0] for r in c.execute(\"select name from sqlite_master where type='table'\")])"
